# RenderJoy — UI with Feel

> Interaction-first React & Next.js UI toolkit with optional Web Audio & haptic feedback, a 58-variant (29 themes × Light/Dark) scoped design token system, standalone WebGL backgrounds, Bench workspace, and Flow UI Kit.

## Status
- Implemented Components: 102 (`109` validated registry items in `public/r/`)
- WebGL Standalone Backgrounds: 18 distinct GPU shader effects (`logo-flare`, `silk`, `prism`, `kinetic-torus`, etc.)
- Sound Library: 56 original procedural Web Audio cues across 8 categories
- Themes: 29 complete token profiles × Light/Dark (58 variants) + 29 static demo websites (`/themes/[themeId]/demo`)

## Registry Installation
Public Namespace: `@renderjoy` (`http://localhost:3000/r/{name}.json`)
Pro Namespace: `@renderjoy-pro` (`/api/pro/registry/{name}` with `Authorization: Bearer ${RENDERJOY_PRO_TOKEN}`)

Configure `components.json`:
```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@renderjoy": "http://localhost:3000/r/{name}.json",
    "@renderjoy-pro": {
      "url": "http://localhost:3000/api/pro/registry/{name}",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer ${RENDERJOY_PRO_TOKEN}"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Install any component:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @renderjoy/<slug>
```

## Key Routes
- `/` — 6-beat editorial homepage with Sculptural Silk Hero & Kinetic Brand Mark
- `/components` — Component Catalogue (102 implemented + Full Inventory)
- `/components/[slug]` — Component Studio (shared `PreviewStage`, DeviceFrames, floating Inspector, docs, CLI)
- `/bench` — Full-canvas side-by-side experimentation workspace
- `/themes` — 29-Theme Studio (58 Light/Dark variants, Compare Mode)
- `/themes/[themeId]/demo` — 29 statically generated full-page theme demo websites
- `/motion` — Motion Lab with live spring & stagger tuner + recipe export
- `/sounds` — Web Audio & Haptics Sound Lab + 56-cue Sound Library
- `/flow` — Node Pipeline Orchestrator (9 typed nodes, Kahn's DAG validation, simulated execution adapter)
- `/pricing` — Open Core & Pro Ecosystem tiers + licence token configurator
- `/docs` & `/docs/installation` — Architecture, AI/MCP discovery, and installation guide
